stem:
The picture shows the coins that are in a piggy bank.

Which dot plot represents the value in cents of each coin in the piggy bank?

options.label: A
options.text: (Dot plot with dots evenly spread across 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45 cents)

options.label: B
options.text: (Dot plot with 5 dots at 5 cents, 2 dots at 10 cents, and 3 dots at 30 cents)

options.label: C
options.text: (Dot plot with 1 dot at 5 cents, 2 dots at 10 cents, 1 dot at 25 cents)

options.label: D
options.text: (Dot plot with 4 dots at 5 cents, 2 dots at 10 cents, 3 dots at 25 cents)

visual_elements: Image of coins: 4 quarters (25 cents), 3 nickels (5 cents), 2 dimes (10 cents)
difficulty_rationale: Requires identifying coin values and counting each to match the correct dot plot, involving modest reasoning with multiple concepts (coin identification, counting, data representation).
